title: Run in P4
description: P4 mark in the run record: whether the run got at least one model answer. Only a run with an answer counts toward the max_runs ceiling; a run that ended before the first answer with a provider reason or core_unavailable is not counted (GW-13, FEN-3).

answered.description: Whether there was at least one model answer.

reason.description: Reason for the end of the run.

counts_to_max_runs.description: Whether the run counts toward max_runs; equals answered.
